title: WHAT IF YOU WERE
*80 FEET* TALL?
disclaimer: A thought experiment · the square-cube law is real

beats.caption: You wake up *14 times* taller than everyone else.
beats.vo: You wake up fourteen times taller than everyone else.

beats.caption: But you're not just taller. You're *2,744 times* heavier.
beats.vo: But you're not just taller. You're two thousand, seven hundred and forty-four times heavier.

beats.caption: Your bones only got *196 times* thicker. Each one carries *14x* the stress.
beats.vo: Your bones only got a hundred and ninety-six times thicker. Each one carries fourteen times the stress.

beats.caption: Every step covers *10 metres*, and the ground shakes.
beats.vo: Every step covers ten metres. And the ground shakes.

beats.caption: Your heart has to pump blood *5 metres* uphill, just to reach your brain.
beats.vo: Your heart has to pump blood five metres uphill, just to reach your brain.

hud.label: Blood pressure needed
hud.sub: A giraffe's heart already strains at ~2x ours

beats.caption: And you'd *overheat*: 2,744x the body, only 196x the skin.
beats.vo: And you'd overheat. Twenty-seven hundred times the body, but only a hundred and ninety-six times the skin.

beats.caption: Keeping that body alive? About *760,000 calories* a day.
beats.vo: Keeping that body alive? About seven hundred and sixty thousand calories a day.

beats.caption: ...your head hits the ground at *over 80 km/h*.
beats.vo: your head hits the ground at over eighty kilometres an hour.

beats.caption: Turns out being *human-sized* is a pretty good deal.
